APISecretRef.description: APISecretRef locates a Kubernetes Secret that holds a bearer token.

key.description: Key is the data key within the Secret whose value is the token.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes Secret name.

namespace.description:
Namespace is the Secret's namespace. Required on an external: call's
auth (in a Blueprint or an e2e step); for gateway API tokens and the
remote reconciler's auth it defaults to Inrun's own namespace.

rotateAfter.description:
RotateAfter is an optional duration (e.g. "90d", "720h").
When set, the gateway checks the inrun.dev/generated-at annotation on
the Secret; if the age exceeds this duration, it deletes and recreates
the Secret with a new uuidv4 token.

Auth.description: Auth is the authentication envelop for handling both ENV-based token and secret reads for cross: authentication

secretRef.description:
SecretRef locates a Kubernetes Secret whose data key holds a bearer token
Mutually exclusive with Token. inrun validate enforces this

token.description: Token is a bearer token for the endpoint. $ENV_VAR syntax supported.

Condition.description: Condition is one test against the CR or runtime state.

between.description: Between passes when the field's number is inside an inclusive "min,max" range.

contains.description: Contains passes when the field's value contains this text.

cron.description:
Cron — a standard cron expression (5-field) that defines when the
window opens. Duration defines how long the window stays open.
Without Duration, the window stays open until the next fire. Add Duration to close it sooner.

dayOfWeek.description:
DayOfWeek — active on the specified days of the week.
  or:
    - dayOfWeek:
        in: [Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday]

duration.description: Duration — how long a cron-opened window remains active.

equals.description: Equals passes when the field's value is exactly this text.

exists.description:
Exists, when true, passes when the field is present and non-empty. A
condition with no comparison at all means exists.

field.description:
Field — dot-notation path to a field in the CR object or a runtime metric.
e.g. "spec.environment", "metrics.queueDepth", "cross.managed-database.metrics.queueDepth"

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan passes when the field's number is above this one (strict).

in.description: In passes when the field's value is one of a comma-separated list.

lessThan.description: LessThan passes when the field's number is below this one (strict).

max.description: Max is an inclusive upper bound: the field's number is at most this.

min.description: Min is an inclusive lower bound: the field's number is at least this.

negate.description:
Negate — when true, the result of this condition is inverted.
Applies to all condition types: field comparisons, time windows, dayOfWeek, cron.

  when:
    - dayOfWeek:
        weekday: true
      negate: true   # passes on weekends

notBetween.description: NotBetween passes when the field's number is outside an inclusive "min,max" range.

notContains.description: NotContains passes when the field's value does not contain this text.

notEquals.description: NotEquals passes when the field's value is not this text.

notExists.description: NotExists, when true, passes when the field is absent or empty.

notIn.description: NotIn passes when the field's value is none of a comma-separated list.

notPrefix.description: NotPrefix passes when the field's value does not start with this text.

notSuffix.description: NotSuffix passes when the field's value does not end with this text.

prefix.description: Prefix passes when the field's value starts with this text.

regex.description: Regex passes when the field's value matches this RE2 pattern.

source.description:
Source is the HTTP fallback for cross-binary metric observation.
Only used when field is a cross.<crd>.metrics.* field and the CRD
is not registered in GlobalCrossMetricsRegistry (different binary).
The endpoint must be the remote operator's /blueprint/{crd} URL.

  when:
    - field: cross.managed-database.metrics.queueDepth
      greaterThan: "500"
      source:
        host: "http://inrun-database-operator:8080"
		   crd: managed-database
  when:
    - field: cross.managed-database.metrics.queueDepth
      greaterThan: "500"
      source:
        endpoint: "http://non-inrun-database-operator:8080/api/managed-database/metrics"

suffix.description: Suffix passes when the field's value ends with this text.

time.description:
Time — active when the current time is within the declared window.
After and Before are both optional; omit one for a half-open range.
  or:
    - time:
        after: "08:00"
        before: "20:00"

typeOf.description:
TypeOf passes when the field's value has this type: map, slice,
string, number, bool or null (the names the typeOf function returns).

unique.description:
Unique, when true, passes when no other instance of the CRD has the same
value at Field. Always passes where no uniqueness checker is available
(e2e, simulate without a seeded fixture).

CrossSource.description: CrossSource declares how to fetch cross-binary/cluster data for a CRD.

auth.description:
Auth handles both ENV-based token and secret reads for cross: authentication
	auth:
	  secretRef:
		name: cross-secret
		namespace: cross-namespace
		key: password

cacheFor.description:
CacheFor controls how long to cache the result before calling again.
Default: 30s — prevents hammering the endpoint on every evaluation.

endpoint.description:
Endpoint is a fully-qualified URL. If set, Inrun uses it directly
and ignores Host/Protocol/Namespace. Template expressions supported.

host.description:
Host is the base URL of a remote Inrun runtime, e.g.:
  http://inrun-runtime.loader-system:8080
Combined with Type to build the final URL.

namespace.description:
Namespace overrides the CR namespace when building info/events URLs.
Optional — defaults to the CR's own namespace.

protocol.description:
Protocol selects which Inrun-native endpoint to call.
One of: "info", "metrics", "health", "events".
Default: "info".

DayOfWeekCondition.description: DayOfWeekCondition declares which days the condition is active.

in.description: In — active on these days. Full English names: Monday, Tuesday, etc.

notIn.description: NotIn — active on all days except these.

weekday.description: Weekday — active Mon–Fri. Shorthand for in: [Monday..Friday].

weekend.description: Weekend — active Sat–Sun. Shorthand for in: [Saturday, Sunday].

Duration.description: A duration: Go units (15s, 2m, 1h) or d, w, mo, y

E2E.description: E2E is the top-level document type for declarative end-to-end tests.

imports.description:
Imports — other E2E files to run after this one, on the same cluster
unless an import sets freshCluster.

metadata.description: Metadata — the test's name and description, shown in results.

spec.description: Spec — the Blueprint under test, the cluster, setup and expectations.

E2ECluster.description: E2ECluster controls cluster creation and selection.

name.description: Name is the kind cluster name. Default: "inrun-e2e".

provider.description: Provider is the cluster backend. Defaults to kind.

reuse.description:
Reuse controls whether an existing cluster is reused or recreated.
false (default) — delete and recreate for a clean state.
true — reuse existing cluster if it exists.

E2ECommand.description: E2ECommand runs a shell command and asserts its result.

between.description: Between — the output, as a number, is inside an inclusive "min,max".

contains.description: Contains — the output contains this text.

equals.description: Equals — the output is exactly this text.

exists.description: Exists — true: the output is non-empty.

exitCode.description:
ExitCode is the expected exit code. Default 0 (success).
Set to non-zero to assert the command must fail — useful for
admission webhook rejection tests.

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan — the output, as a number, is above this one (strict).

in.description: In — the output is one of a comma-separated list.

jq.description: JQ selects one value from JSON output with a jq expression (requires format: json and jq).

json.description:
JSON asserts on several values in JSON output in one block. In-process.
Runs after JQ extraction if set
(JQ output must itself be valid JSON when JSON is present).

jsonPath.description: JSONPath selects one value from JSON output by dot path (in-process).

lessThan.description: LessThan — the output, as a number, is below this one (strict).

max.description: Max — the output, as a number, is at most this.

min.description: Min — the output, as a number, is at least this.

notBetween.description: NotBetween — the output, as a number, is outside an inclusive "min,max".

notContains.description: NotContains — the output does not contain this text.

notEquals.description: NotEquals — the output is not this text.

notExists.description: NotExists — true: the output is empty.

notIn.description: NotIn — the output is none of a comma-separated list.

notPrefix.description: NotPrefix — the output does not start with this text.

notSuffix.description: NotSuffix — the output does not end with this text.

prefix.description: Prefix — the output starts with this text.

regex.description: Regex — the output matches this RE2 pattern.

run.description: Run is a shell command string executed via sh -c.

suffix.description: Suffix — the output ends with this text.

yq.description: YQ selects one value from YAML output with a yq expression (requires format: yaml yq).

E2ECustomConfig.description: E2ECustomConfig declares the target runtime when testing non-Inrun workloads.

target.description:
Target is the runtime environment under test. Supported values: "kubernetes".
"container" is reserved for future use.

E2EExpectation.description: E2EExpectation is one named assertion block.

after.description:
After is the lifecycle event that triggers this expectation.
Valid values: "setup-complete", "cr-applied", "cr-deleted".

commands.description: Commands are shell commands checked in the same polling loop as resources.

env.description:
Env declares environment variables available to this expectation.
Overrides variables declared in the parent E2E spec.

external.description:
External makes the calls a Blueprint's external: makes — HTTP,
Prometheus, Postgres, Redis, Mongo, Kafka — from the machine running the
test, and asserts on what they return. The step passes when every call
succeeds and its assertions hold.

finally.description:
Finally declares operations to run after this expectation completes —
whether it passed, failed or was skipped — before the next expectation
runs. Operations are never asserted on; failures are printed, not
counted. Use it to undo mutations the step made to files or cluster
state.

include.description:
Include is a path to a YAML file containing a list of E2EExpectation entries.
When set, the file is loaded and its entries are expanded in place of this entry.
All other fields must be empty when include is set.
Relative paths resolve from the e2e.yaml directory.

kubectl.description:
Kubectl is the structured kubectl DSL block.
An alternative to commands: for common kubectl operations — get, logs,
describe, exec, port-forward. Compiles to kubectl invocations internally.
Use commands: for anything that doesn't fit a subcommand.

name.description: Name is printed in the results table.

onFailure.description:
OnFailure declares diagnostic operations to run immediately when this
specific expectation fails. Runs before moving to the next expectation.

or.description: Or — at least one condition must pass, alongside When.

resources.description: Resources is a unified list of resource checks across any kind.

timeout.description: Timeout is the maximum time to wait for the expectation to pass.

wait.description:
Wait is an optional duration to sleep before the polling loop starts.
Useful when the previous step needs time to take effect before assertions
should begin — e.g. waiting for enough reconcile cycles to accumulate.
Must be a valid Go duration string (e.g. "10s", "30s").

when.description:
When / Or gate this expectation using the same []Condition type as
blueprint when:/or:. An expectation whose conditions do not pass is
skipped — not failed. Functions declared in spec.functions are available as
template expressions: field: '{{ inBusinessHours }}'.
Empty blocks always pass.

E2EExternalCheck.description: E2EExternalCheck is one call an e2e step makes and asserts on.

auth.description:
Auth declares the credential for this call. For the remote request:
default remote.auth.

between.description: Between — the output, as a number, is inside an inclusive "min,max".

body.description:
Body is the request body for POST/PUT/PATCH. Template expressions supported.
  body: '{"name": "{{ .metadata.name }}"}'
HTTP only.

cacheFor.description:
CacheFor gates re-fetch. Calls within this window return the cached result.
Empty: fetch every reconcile. Recommended for stateful protocols where
connection establishment is expensive.

contains.description: Contains — the output contains this text.

continueOnError.description:
ContinueOnError controls whether a failed call halts reconciliation.
false (default): failure returns an error, halting the reconcile.
true:            failure is logged, result has error set, reconcile continues.

equals.description: Equals — the output is exactly this text.

exists.description: Exists — true: the output is non-empty.

expectedStatus.description:
ExpectedStatus lists the HTTP status codes that count as success, e.g.
[200, 404] for a read where "not found" is an answer. HTTP only.
Default: any status below 400.

fires.description:
Fires controls at which lifecycle points this call executes.
Absent: fires at both admission and reconcile time.
fires.reconcile: false — admission only; reconciler skips this call.

greaterThan.description: GreaterThan — the output, as a number, is above this one (strict).

headers.description:
Headers are additional HTTP headers. Values are templates, like url and
body; names are literal. Credentials belong in auth, not here. HTTP only.
  headers:
    X-Tenant: "{{ .metadata.namespace }}"

idempotencyKey.description:
IdempotencyKey controls the key Inrun sends on POST and PATCH so a
retried write is not applied twice. Absent: sent as Idempotency-Key with
a key derived from the CR's UID and the request. HTTP only.
  idempotencyKey: false
  idempotencyKey: {header: PayPal-Request-Id}

in.description: In — the output is one of a comma-separated list.

include.description:
Include is a path to a YAML file containing a top-level "calls:" list.
When set, this entry is replaced in-place by the listed calls.
Resolved relative to the blueprint file's directory. Cleared after expansion.

jq.description: JQ selects one value from JSON output with a jq expression (requires format: json and jq).

json.description:
JSON asserts on several values in JSON output in one block. In-process.
Runs after JQ extraction if set
(JQ output must itself be valid JSON when JSON is present).

jsonPath.description: JSONPath selects one value from JSON output by dot path (in-process).

lessThan.description: LessThan — the output, as a number, is below this one (strict).

max.description: Max — the output, as a number, is at most this.

method.description:
Method is the HTTP method. Default: GET for external calls, POST for
the remote request. HTTP only.

min.description: Min — the output, as a number, is at least this.

name.description:
Name is the identifier used to access the result in template expressions.
  name: health-check → {{ .external.health-check.status }}

notBetween.description: NotBetween — the output, as a number, is outside an inclusive "min,max".

notContains.description: NotContains — the output does not contain this text.

notEquals.description: NotEquals — the output is not this text.

notExists.description: NotExists — true: the output is empty.

notIn.description: NotIn — the output is none of a comma-separated list.

notPrefix.description: NotPrefix — the output does not start with this text.

notSuffix.description: NotSuffix — the output does not end with this text.

or.description: Or — at least one condition must pass, alongside When.

poolSize.description:
PoolSize is the maximum connections maintained per url:.
Only meaningful for stateful protocols (postgres, kafka, redis, nats, mqtt).
Default: 2.

prefix.description: Prefix — the output starts with this text.

protocol.description:
Protocol identifies the wire protocol. Default (Empty(): HTTP.
  protocol: prometheus
  protocol: redis
  protocol: postgres

query.description:
Query is a protocol-specific instruction executed after connection.
HTTP: unused (use body: for request body).
Prometheus: PromQL expression.
Postgres: SQL query string.
Redis: command and args — "GET mykey", "HGET hash field".
Kafka: "consumer-group/topic" or "@topic" for topic metadata.
NATS: "bucket.key" for KV; stream name for stream info.
MQTT: retained topic to read.

regex.description: Regex — the output matches this RE2 pattern.

suffix.description: Suffix — the output ends with this text.

timeout.description:
Timeout is the maximum duration for this call. Format: "5s", "1m",
"500ms". Default: 10s for external calls, remote.timeout for the
remote request.

url.description:
URL is the endpoint or connection string. Template expressions supported.
  url: "{{ .spec.serviceUrl }}/health"
  url: "redis://redis-svc:6379"
For the remote request and finalize: default remote.endpoint.

when.description: When — every condition must pass for the call to be made this pass.

yq.description: YQ selects one value from YAML output with a yq expression (requires format: yaml yq).

E2EFinally.description: Declares operations to run after an expectation completes — whether it passed, failed or was skipped — before the next expectation runs.

commands.description: Commands — shell commands to run, each with sh -c.

kubectl.description:
Kubectl — kubectl operations to run, in the same form as expect
entries; their assertions are ignored.

anyOf.description: E2EImport references another E2E file to run after this one completes.

freshCluster.description:
FreshCluster provisions a new kind cluster for this import instead of
reusing the parent's cluster. Default: false (share parent cluster).

path.description: Path is the path to another E2E spec file (must be kind: E2E).

wait.description:
Wait is an optional duration to sleep before this import starts.
Useful when the previous test leaves cluster state that needs time to
clear — webhook deregistration, namespace termination, cert provisioning.
Must be a valid Go duration string (e.g. "10s", "1m30s").

E2EImport.description: E2EImport references another E2E file to run after this one completes.

E2EInit.description: E2EInit selects a built-in example pack as the test source.

example.description: Example — the example inside the pack to test.

pack.description: Pack — the example pack, as in inrun init --pack.

E2EKubectl.description: E2EKubectl is the structured kubectl DSL block.

apply.description:
Apply applies manifests from a file path or inline YAML/JSON content.
Generates: kubectl apply -f <file>  or  echo '<inline>' | kubectl apply -f -

auth.description:
Auth checks permissions via kubectl auth can-i and asserts the result.
Generates: kubectl auth can-i <verb> <resource> [-n <ns>] [--as <as>]

cp.description:
Cp copies a file out of a container and asserts its content.
Generates: kubectl cp <ns>/<pod>:<src> <tempfile>

delete.description:
Delete deletes resources by file path or by resource identity.
Generates: kubectl delete -f <file>  or  kubectl delete <kind> <name> -n <ns>

describe.description:
Describe asserts kubectl describe output — useful for events and conditions.
Generates: kubectl describe <kind> <name> -n <ns>

events.description:
Events lists Kubernetes events for a specific resource and asserts the output.
Generates: kubectl events --for=<kind>/<name> -n <ns>

exec.description:
Exec runs a command inside a running container and asserts its output.
Generates: kubectl exec -n <ns> <pod> -c <container> -- <command>

get.description:
Get asserts field values on Kubernetes resources.
Generates: kubectl get <kind> <name> -n <ns> -o jsonpath='<field>'

logs.description:
Logs asserts container log output.
Generates: kubectl logs -n <ns> -l <selector> -c <container> --since=<since>

patch.description:
Patch patches a Kubernetes resource with a merge, strategic, or JSON patch.
Generates: kubectl patch <kind> <name> -n <ns> --type=<type> -p '<patch>'

port-forward.description:
PortForward opens a port-forward to a service or pod, makes an HTTP request,
and asserts the response. EnsureCurl is called automatically when any entry
declares a path. Generates: kubectl port-forward + curl.

restart.description:
Restart triggers a rollout restart of a Deployment, StatefulSet, or DaemonSet.
Generates: kubectl rollout restart <kind>/<name> -n <ns>
Waits for the rollout to complete when ready: true (default).
The expect step's timeout governs how long to wait.

scale.description:
Scale sets the replica count on a Deployment, StatefulSet, or ReplicaSet.
Generates: kubectl scale <kind>/<name> --replicas=<n> -n <ns>
Waits for the rollout to complete when ready: true (default).
The expect step's timeout governs how long to wait.

top.description:
Top queries live CPU and memory usage via kubectl top and asserts the output.
Requires metrics-server; installed automatically when entries are present.
Generates: kubectl top <kind> [-n <ns>] [<name> | -l <selector>] [--containers]

between.description: Between — the output, as a number, is inside an inclusive "min,max".

Body is sent as the request body for methods that accept one (POST,
PUT, PATCH). Ignored for GET/HEAD/DELETE. Goes through os.ExpandEnv,
same as Headers.

resolve against the E2E file's directory. Goes through os.ExpandEnv.
Mutually exclusive with Body.

Content-Type header is already declared. Convenience for posting a
full CR manifest read from BodyFile.

endpoint like the Gateway API. Values go through os.ExpandEnv
(same ${VAR} syntax as gateway.api.auth.tokens.token), so a CI
secret never needs to be written into the YAML file.

	headers:
	  Authorization: "Bearer ${INRUN_CI_TOKEN}"

E2EOnFailure.description: E2EOnFailure declares operations to run when an expectation fails.

commands.description: Commands — shell commands to run, each with sh -c.

kubectl.description:
Kubectl — kubectl operations to run, in the same form as expect
entries; their assertions are ignored.

stop.description:
Stop halts the run after the diagnostics for this failure. At spec
level it applies to any expectation that fails; at expectation level it
applies only to that one. The failure is still recorded and reported;
Stop only decides whether later expectations run.

E2EResourceCheck.description: E2EResourceCheck asserts the state of any Kubernetes resource.

count.description:
Count asserts the exact number of matching resources. nil means "at least 1".
Set to 0 to assert none exist (cleanup check).

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind: Deployment, Service, Secret, ConfigMap.

name.description: Name is the resource name. Empty means any resource of this kind in the namespace.

namespace.description: Namespace to look in. Empty means "default".

ready.description: Ready asserts at least one available replica (Deployments only).

enabled.description:
Enabled controls whether Inrun runtime health checks are performed.
Defaults to true.

blueprint.description:
Blueprint is the path to the blueprint.yaml file.
Optional when spec.custom.target is set.

cluster.description: Cluster controls which cluster to use.

cr.description: CR is the path to the CR YAML file to apply during the test.

crFiles.description:
CRFiles is a list of additional CR YAML files. Applied in declaration order
after CR. Use when the test needs multiple CR instances or kinds.

crd.description:
CRD is the path to the CRD YAML file for this operator.
Applied before the bundle and before Inrun starts.

crdFiles.description:
CRDFiles is a list of additional CRD YAML files. Applied in declaration order
after CRD. Use when the operator manages multiple custom resource

custom.description:
Custom declares the target runtime for this e2e test when it is not an
Inrun-managed operator. Inrun still owns the cluster lifecycle, setup,
CR apply, assertions, and cleanup — only the bundle generation and
Inrun helm install/uninstall are skipped.

Use this when your operator, Helm chart, or any Kubernetes workload is
installed via setup.helm or is already present in the cluster.
See the custom target in docs/reference/schema/e2e/complete-example.md.

env.description:
Env declares environment variables available to all expectations in this
e2e spec. Values support variable expansion.

expect.description: Expect is the list of expectations to check after each lifecycle event.

functions.description:
Functions declares user-defined functions available in when:/or: expressions.
Same syntax as a Blueprint functions block — same FuncMap registration, same functions.

init.description: Init uses an example pack — for Inrun's own CI.

onFailure.description:
OnFailure declares kubectl operations and commands to run and print to the
terminal when any expectation fails. Uses the same kubectl: DSL as expect
entries — assertions are never evaluated; output is always printed.

runtime.description: Runtime controls runtime-specific behavior during the e2e test.

setup.description:
Setup declares prerequisite resources to apply before Inrun starts.
Shorthand: a plain list of strings applies each file
Struct form adds helm installs and resource waiting.

valuesFiles.description:
ValuesFiles is a list of Helm values files passed to the Inrun chart
installation during e2e. Paths are relative to the e2e.yaml file.
Use this to configure custom runtime images or any other Helm values
without requiring --values flags on the command line — useful when e2e
runs automatically during inrun push.

ExternalAuth.description: ExternalAuth declares how to resolve a credential for an external call.

env.description:
Env reads the credential from a pod environment variable.
Value is the variable name without $: env: MY_TOKEN reads $MY_TOKEN.

header.description:
Header is the HTTP header the credential is injected into.
Default: "Authorization" (produces "Bearer <value>").
Set to "X-Api-Key" or similar for non-Bearer schemes.
HTTP only — ignored by stateful protocol clients.

secretRef.description:
SecretRef reads the credential from a Kubernetes Secret.
Namespace defaults to the operator's own namespace if omitted.
Read via the API server watch cache — no etcd round-trip.

FiresConfig.description: FiresConfig controls at which lifecycle points an external call is executed.

reconcile.description:
Reconcile controls whether the call fires at reconcile time.
Default true. Set false for admission-only calls (e.g. image signing checks)
where the admission check is trusted and re-running every reconcile is wasteful.

anyOf.description: IdempotencyKeyConfig overrides the idempotency key Inrun sends on POST and PATCH.

header.description: Header is the header name. Default: Idempotency-Key.

value.description:
Value is a template for the key, for an API with its own key format.
Default: derived from the CR's UID, the method, the URL and the body.

include.description:
Include — a YAML file, relative to this one, whose definitions: list is
added before the definitions here.

anyOf.description: RetryBackoffConfig is declared under queue.retryBackoff or external[].retryBackoff.

initial.description: Initial is the first backoff delay. Default: 500ms.

max.description: Max caps the delay so it does not grow unboundedly. Default: 30s.

maxAttempts.description: MaxAttempts is the total number of calls including the first. Default: 3.

multiplier.description: Multiplier scales the delay after each attempt. Default: 2.0.

wait.description: Wait blocks after this apply until all listed resources satisfy their conditions.

apply.description:
Apply is an ordered list of manifests to kubectl-apply.
Each entry is either a plain path string or a {path, wait} struct.
Applied first, before helm installs, after the CRD is installed.

helm.description:
Helm is an ordered list of Helm charts to install before Inrun starts.
Executed as helm upgrade --install — not rendered for Blueprint extraction.

wait.description:
Wait blocks until all listed resources exist and satisfy conditions.
Runs after all apply and helm steps. Use per-entry wait for ordered checks.

chart.description: Chart is the chart name within the repository, or a local path (e.g. ./).

namespace.description: Namespace for the release. Defaults to "default".

release.description: Release is the Helm release name. Defaults to the chart name when empty.

repo.description: Repo is the Helm repository URL. Omit for local chart paths.

valueFiles.description: ValueFiles is an ordered list of values files (local paths or URLs).

values.description: Values are inline key-value overrides, equivalent to helm --set.

version.description: Version pins the chart version. Leave empty for latest or local charts.

kind.description: Kind is the Kubernetes resource kind (e.g. Deployment, Secret, Namespace).

name.description: Name is the exact resource name.

namespace.description: Namespace to look in. Omit for cluster-scoped resources.

ready.description: Ready waits for an available/ready condition, not just existence.

timeout.description: Timeout is a Go duration string. Default: "30s".

TimeWindow.description: TimeWindow declares a clock-based active window.

after.description: After — active after this time (format: "HH:MM" in 24h).

before.description: Before — active before this time (format: "HH:MM" in 24h).

UserDefinedFunction.description: UserDefinedFunction is a named template expression declared in a Blueprint or Module.

description.description: Description — shown by inrun validate and in the function list.

expression.description:
Expression is a Go template string evaluated by the Resolver.
Built-in functions and other user-defined functions (same Blueprint or imported) are
available inside the expression. The result is always a string.

name.description: Name — how templates call the function.

shadow.description: Shadow: true acknowledges that this function intentionally overrides a built-in.
